scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Current parked article and evacuated/buoyant state
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md What is still missing entirely; docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md Both directions
entries.units: configuration identity; pressure Pa; displacement m3; orientation rad; timestamp
entries.method: Request a matched article/drawing/version identity, pressure and buoyant state, geometry, orientation and parked interval, with calibration and uncertainty.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A historical evacuated article is not the current build configuration or a demonstrated stationary state. Drawing/bill disagreements remain unresolved.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Mooring, supports and complete ground load path
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md What is still missing entirely; docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Fittings, torsion straps and retired skin
entries.units: restraint/component identity; geometry m; signed force N; moment N m; time s
entries.method: Request as-installed restraint, support/contact and attachment identities, geometry, coordinate/sign conventions and synchronized force/moment observations along the complete path to ground; retain missing interfaces.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: No mooring/support configuration or ground attachment is selected. Named aerial cables or structural anchors do not demonstrate ground restraint; missing interfaces remain UNKNOWN.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Matched parked mass and changing inventories
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md Film, close-up fittings and outfit; docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md What is still missing entirely
entries.method: Request itemized dry/outfit/ground equipment, payload, water and nitrogen inventories and transfer histories matched to the same parked state, with measured uncertainty and explicit missing items.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Outfit and installation mass are unknown, never zero. Historical downward snow or upward buoyancy quantities are not a complete current inventory or observed net ground load.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Seasonal wind, snow, icing and local conditions
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md What is still missing entirely
entries.units: wind vector m/s; direction rad; pressure Pa; temperature K; deposited mass kg; thickness m; time s
entries.method: Request calibrated time-resolved ambient conditions, local coordinate/exposure description, accumulation/icing state and coverage/missing intervals for the matched article and restraint interval.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Published wind/snow quantities and off-season assumptions are historical context, not a forecast, measured environment or operating envelope. No site, weather case or operating limit is selected.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Observed stationary behaviour and changing restraint/contact state
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md What is still missing entirely
entries.units: position m; orientation rad; velocity m/s; signed reaction N; time s
entries.method: Request synchronized position/orientation, motion, reaction and contact/restraint-state histories, including inventory/environment changes, transients, losses of restraint and missing intervals, with calibration and uncertainty.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The source explicitly lacks a demonstrated state in which the aircraft sits still. A drawing or assumed load does not establish stationary behaviour, failure tolerance or a safe parked state.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Complete installed ground-equipment and interface provenance
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md outfit; docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Fittings, torsion straps and retired skin
entries.units: component/record identity; count; geometry m; kg; calibration identity
entries.method: Request a complete installed equipment manifest, drawings, support/attachment interfaces, inspection/configuration history and raw calibrated observations tied to each parked article; keep unallocated items explicit.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Named outfit and schematic pulleys/lines are not a weighed, installed or qualified ground-handling system. This paper does not duplicate the material/strength or installation crosswalk.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Matched raw records, uncertainty and separate physical criteria
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md What is still missing entirely; docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md Recorded disagreements
entries.units: record identity; synchronization error s; uncertainty units per quantity
entries.method: Request raw records, instrument/calibration provenance, shared clock/coordinate transformations, processing versions, uncertainty components/correlations and invalidating conditions; record any later acceptance decision separately.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Observations, measured uncertainty, allowable movement/load and all physical acceptance criteria are missing. Retain failures and unfavourable or incomplete records; do not invent pass thresholds.
